expected.finding: **[P1]** Secret redaction misses valid curl credentials in [improvement_policy.py:114](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:114). `curl -uadmin:[REDACTED] ...` survives unchanged because the pattern requires whitespace or `=` after `-u`. Quoted passwords containing spaces also leak their trailing words. I reproduced five synthetic failures flowing through mining into an accepted revision: the password appeared in both `mined_from` and the generated keywords. The workflow would publish these in the policy PR. Handle attached arguments and complete quoted values before reporting or mining.
